newsitem.title: ITALY: Fincantieri hands over cruise ship to P&O.
newsitem.headline: Fincantieri hands over cruise ship to P&O.

text.p: Italian state-controlled shipbuilder Fincantieri said on Saturday it had handed over to British shipping group Peninsula and Oriental Steam Navigation Co (P&O) the luxury cruise ship "Dawn Princess."

A Fincantieri statement said that the "Dawn Princess" which has a passenger capacity of over 2,300 and a crew of over 800 will become part of the fleet of Princess Cruises, a P&O company based in Los Angles.
Fincantieri said the "Dawn Princess" is sister to the "Sun Princess" also built at Fincantieri's Monfalcone shipyard, near Trieste, and handed over to P&O in November 1995.

The handing over ceremony on Saturday was attended by Fincantieri chairman and chief executive officer Corrado Antonini, P&O chairman Lord Jeffrey Sterling and Michele Tedeschi chairman of state industrial holding IRI, the group which controls Fincantieri.
The shipbuilder said the handing over of the "Dawn Princess" confirmed the group's leadership in the field of large cruise ships with a market share exceeding 40 percent in terms of gross tonnage.
